g.text: Runtime and realized rejection on fixed inputs
Same four cost matrices and forbidden masks at every limit. Top: median and timing-round IQR. Bottom: mean unmatched fraction.
Different optimal pair sets/cardinalities at ties are permitted; objectives are checked. The limit axis includes zero using a symmetric-log scale.
